items: After the Quantum Ledger chargeback we accidentally closed last quarter, I want the agent to ask me before update_ticket_state on any tickets.state of open ticket in Billing once tickets.age_hours hits 8.
Routing a chargeback into the Legal group via move_ticket_to_group should never happen without my confirmation; the implication is a litigation hold and I want to be in the loop.
If the customer is dana@example.com or charlie@example.com, do not reassign_ticket_owner away from marta.billing@example.com without asking; both have ongoing chargeback patterns we are tracking.
I pre-clear move_ticket_to_group between Billing and Legal up to tickets.age_hours of 36 because that's our normal handoff window and we run aging reports off it.
The agent can reassign_ticket_owner to leah.legal@example.com or tom.legal@example.com on any open Billing ticket without asking; both already triage these queues daily.

Closing a tickets.priority of 1 low Billing ticket via update_ticket_state to closed is fine without confirmation, and update_ticket_priority adjustments inside Billing are pre-cleared; I only want a heads-up before delete_ticket.
